_note: Coordinator addendum (2026-10-16): the post-apply verifier deleted the AIX contract from the Applied Materials -> Micron edge (process tools for DRAM fab) because it describes a service deployment, and suggested keeping the fact as Applied quarterly_data with Micron as counterparty. Statements are Tim Deane's (Head of Applied Global Services); Micron's own video is not used.

quarterly_data.signal: Customer Micron: Head of Applied Global Services Tim Deane said 'Manish and Micron have been a great partner as we fanned AIX out into their factories' (AIX = Applied's Actionable Insight Acceleration connected-services platform).

AIX service examples (Tim Deane): with AIX Pro, nozzle positioning is set from a single review of the metrology map, taking 'six iterations down to two iterations', which 'saves about 65% of the time for maintenance'; a new sensor on the front end of the etch system, connected to the customer's MES and Applied's AIX servers, fine-tunes placement in each etch chamber to fix tilted etches at the wafer edge ('In most wafers today, 6%-10% of the die are on the outside edge of the wafer'); after seeing the data the customer 'immediately fanned this out across their entire installed base of these tools', and a second-generation solution is in process.
quarterly_data.figure: about 65% maintenance time saved; 6%-10% of die at the wafer edge
